items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: this trumpet player, he played just like Harry James.

ctx.x: Well, we were movin' so fast... I'll never forget one day I became exuberant and so I says, "Come on, Al McKibbon, let's go eat." And I ordered a whole lot of stuff and we all ate good and there was somebody else there and so when the tab come Al McKibbon says, "Man, my God man..." Hahahaha. But

the food was so good and then, at that time, the weather was warm and...oh, at first, we were staying at that very exclusive hotel and oh it was somethin'. It was so expensive we had to get out of there, so we moved to another, a little hotel on the side street. (laughter) But when I was there I went out one night and I caught Earl Hines...no, whad I do?... I went out one night and, who did I catch, somebody that'd been in Europe since the '20's, a trumpet player. I forget his name.* I had a good time jammin'…
You played concert dates there, did you? Or did you play some club dates as well?
